name: Ordinal TN coverage profile
description: Input-shape and boundary checklist for ordinal TN tests.

scenarios.description: Ordinal with suffix or ordinal marker.
Roman numeral ordinal/name context when the language supports it.

risk_scenarios.description: Bare digits should usually be cardinal, not ordinal, without suffix or ordinal context.
Roman-like tokens may be names, letters, or serials unless context justifies ordinal/roman ownership.
